dataset: Source Finder Vol. 2 - UCC Search Directory for Agents - FREE SAMPLE
note: Free sample with entries for AR, TX, DE, OK, WY, CA, FL. Full version on Gumroad (bradray2): all 50 states + DC with cost, login, agent-access and portal-quirk notes for every entry.

entries.agency: Arkansas Secretary of State - Business & Commercial Services
entries.answers: What UCC financing statements (liens) are filed against a debtor in Arkansas, and what is their status? Used for lender, vendor, and acquisition due diligence.
entries.notes: $6 per search per SOS FAQ (with or without results). $150/yr subscriber account required for electronic filers.

entries.answers: What UCC financing statements (liens) are filed against a debtor in California, and what is their status? Used for lender, vendor, and acquisition due diligence.
entries.notes: Official bizfile portal. Free UCC searches via the UCC Online portal per 2020 SOS press release; account only needed to file or order documents.

entries.agency: Delaware Department of State - Division of Corporations
entries.answers: What UCC financing statements (liens) are filed against a debtor in Delaware, and what is their status? Used for lender, vendor, and acquisition due diligence.
entries.notes: Restricted: all non-Search-to-Reflect searches are performed only by a Delaware Authorized Searcher. $25/debtor fee reported by third-party source.

entries.agency: Florida Department of State - Florida Secured Transaction Registry
entries.answers: What UCC financing statements (liens) are filed against a debtor in Florida, and what is their status? Used for lender, vendor, and acquisition due diligence.
entries.notes: UCC filing privatized to state vendor Image API, LLC (per dos.fl.gov/sunbiz). Search free; no login.

entries.answers: What UCC financing statements (liens) are filed against a debtor in Oklahoma, and what is their status? Used for lender, vendor, and acquisition due diligence.
entries.notes: Not at SOS: Oklahoma County Clerk is the central UCC filing office for all 77 counties. Site is the search app itself (UCC search anchors on page). Search free; document copies paid via checkout; account needed to purchase.

entries.answers: What UCC financing statements (liens) are filed against a debtor in Texas, and what is their status? Used for lender, vendor, and acquisition due diligence.
entries.notes: Portal fetched; official SOS modernization page links it as the new SOSPortal. New SOS UCC Portal requires SOS Portal account with MFA; SOSDirect retired Sept 29 2026. New-portal searches reported at ~$1 statutory fee per search (official fee schedule is JS-rendered; fee not independently confirmed).

entries.answers: What UCC financing statements (liens) are filed against a debtor in Wyoming, and what is their status? Used for lender, vendor, and acquisition due diligence.
entries.notes: Official SOS UCC page links to this as the UCC/EFS/Buyer E-Filing System for authorized users (resolves to the portal, HTTP 200). Online searches require a paid UCC E-filing subscription ($150/year plus a prepaid PAD account, minimum $200 deposit). A paper UCC-11 certified search costs $10 per debtor.
